annotations.title: Archive an Outbrain campaign or delete an unused budget

description: ARCHIVE an Outbrain campaign (Outbrain has no campaign delete: say ARCHIVED, never deleted; it drops out of the campaign lists and its promoted links go with it) or DELETE a budget no campaign uses and that has spent nothing (Outbrain refuses any other). Call it WITHOUT confirm FIRST: that only reads and says what would be lost; then confirm:true, plus confirmName (the exact name) and confirmChildren when the answer asks for them, after the user says yes. set_outbrain_ads_status paused stops spending without archiving. Read back. Free.

confirmChildren.description: the promoted link count, when asked
